name: smoketest-drive
description: Minimal brand-kit fixture for the copy-pipeline-watch end-to-end smoke test. Wires a Google Drive watch folder → google-drive Destination round-trip with no RAG and one Gemini Flash candidate.

marketing.description: Smoke-test canonical. In a real consumer this points at a written brand voice spec. The rules file is generic prose-lint to prove brand-review bites.

models.description: Single candidate via Vertex Model Garden — Gemini Flash. Single GCP auth path, no vendor keys. Add anthropic-vertex/claude-* candidates once Vertex Model Garden activation is approved (one-time accept-Anthropic-ToS step per project).

destinations.description: Drive folders the daemon writes back into.

drive-reviewed.description: Picked variants land here for the content team to review.

drive-needs-attention.description: Generate failures + total publish failures land here with an error marker.

drive-suggestions.description: Proposer agent writes evidence-backed brand-kit improvement proposals here. The operator reviews + approves/rejects.

input_sources.description: Drive watch folder — drop a doc here and the daemon will fire.

config.brief_template: Apply the brand canonical to the following document. Improve clarity and voice without changing intent. Preserve structure unless a section is clearly broken.
